claim: AI can compress initial obligation research but cannot determine every lease duty asset condition or premises fact
countervailingForce: Versioned rules structured questions and professional escalation can bound the role
leadingIndicator: Share of obligation cases escalated and wrong-jurisdiction rate
commercialImplication: Sell guided evidence collection and escalation rather than an automated legal answer
limitations: No task-specific evaluation set exists

claim: Cheap generated explainers checklists and location pages remove scarcity from generic compliance content
countervailingForce: Original enforcement data calculators provider verification and operational evidence remain scarce
leadingIndicator: Index growth and assisted enquiries for pages with versus without original inputs
commercialImplication: Do not fund a compliance content factory as the core asset
limitations: The quantity and quality distribution of new pages is unmeasured

claim: Answer interfaces can satisfy generic compliance questions before a visitor reaches a publisher
countervailingForce: High-intent quote needs current provider capacity and premises-specific qualification
leadingIndicator: Generative-search impressions visits accepted leads and assisted conversion by page type
commercialImplication: Treat content as a measured acquisition surface rather than a durable product
limitations: Click evidence is US-wide and not UK compliance-query data

claim: A purchasing agent can route a well-specified job directly to a public register or known provider and bypass a thin lead seller
countervailingForce: Live scope capacity insurance conflict and outcome data are not generally contained in one public register
leadingIndicator: Share of bookings initiated by agents and provider-feed coverage
commercialImplication: Own verified operational context and completion evidence or expect lead margins to compress
limitations: No live agent-mediated provider cohort exists

claim: AI can map accepted notes and photos into structured report drafts
countervailingForce: Competent review and no-source-no-claim controls remain mandatory
leadingIndicator: Reviewer minutes unsupported sentences and critical-action errors
commercialImplication: Provider productivity can improve without automating professional judgement
limitations: Vendor claims are not independent outcome evidence

claim: When reporting is half of an eight-hour job a 40 percent report-time reduction creates a 25 percent theoretical capacity uplift
countervailingForce: Travel field time demand and review can remain bottlenecks
leadingIndicator: Completed assessments per assessor day with stable defect and complaint rates
commercialImplication: Savings exist but are smaller than the headline report-writing reduction
limitations: Scenario inputs are assumed and not a provider time study

claim: PlanRadar SafetyCulture and MaintainX already bundle document search form generation inspection records or anomaly detection
countervailingForce: A vertical service can differentiate through responsibility provider operations and evidence quality
leadingIndicator: Feature parity win-loss and customer switching reasons
commercialImplication: Generic AI workflow features cannot support premium standalone pricing
limitations: Vendor capability statements do not prove customer adoption

claim: AI can extract dates assets findings and actions from heterogeneous reports when every field retains a source span
countervailingForce: OCR errors and confabulation require confidence thresholds and human review
leadingIndicator: Critical-field precision and time per ingested report
commercialImplication: Evidence ingestion is a credible wedge if it beats manual entry without losing lineage
limitations: No authorised report corpus has been evaluated

claim: AI can resolve names and surface likely credential matches but deterministic register checks and human approval must control routing
countervailingForce: Public registers scope restrictions expiries and insurance evidence support verification
leadingIndicator: Critical credential error and routing reversal rates
commercialImplication: Credential orchestration is valuable but a false match creates concentrated liability
limitations: Register access structure and refresh terms vary

claim: AI does not remove the need to observe premises equipment systems and material condition in the physical world
countervailingForce: Remote sensing and better evidence capture may reduce repeat visits in bounded cases
leadingIndicator: Field hours per completed assessment and remote-only exception rate
commercialImplication: Physical delivery keeps qualified providers inside the value chain
limitations: Future sensors may change individual checks rather than the whole duty

claim: Use of software or contractors does not transfer the dutyholder's responsibility and AI cannot sign as a competent person
countervailingForce: Better records can support rather than replace accountability
leadingIndicator: Unauthorised sign-offs false closures and named-human acceptance rate
commercialImplication: Design the product around accountable approvals instead of autonomous compliance claims
limitations: Liability allocation requires professional review and contracts

claim: Operating the workflow can create a private graph of assets findings provider performance remediation time recurrence and cost
countervailingForce: Data remains weak if customers do not grant access or records are inconsistent
leadingIndicator: Sites with complete histories provider outcome coverage and repeat defects predicted
commercialImplication: The evidence graph is a stronger asset than generated reports
limitations: Data rights retention and predictive value are untested

claim: Recurring exception handling and provider coordination can deepen the portfolio relationship beyond a one-off certificate
countervailingForce: Incumbent facilities managers and software suites already own many relationships
leadingIndicator: Gross retention sites per account and share of lanes coordinated
commercialImplication: Win a narrow high-friction loop before expanding across compliance lanes
limitations: No customer retention cohort exists

claim: Search engines model APIs public registers and incumbent workflow platforms can each control a critical interface
countervailingForce: Provider relationships exported records and model portability reduce dependency
leadingIndicator: Revenue concentration by channel model provider and integration
commercialImplication: No channel or model provider should be the only route to demand or operation
limitations: Future interface shares are unknown

claim: A partner-led operator can remain useful if it owns verified histories provider execution and accountable exception resolution
countervailingForce: Incumbents can copy software features and providers may build direct portals
leadingIndicator: Renewal share multi-lane expansion exclusive evidence and provider SLA performance
commercialImplication: Test operations first and build only the data and controls generic tools lack
limitations: Willingness to pay and contractual defensibility are unknown

claim: Guidance plus AI may help competent operators of simple low-risk premises complete more work internally
countervailingForce: Complexity vulnerable occupants insurer expectations and limited competence drive external help
leadingIndicator: External assessment purchase rate by premises risk class
commercialImplication: Do not calculate TAM by multiplying all premises by an assessor fee
limitations: Safe AI-assisted self-assessment has not been evaluated

claim: AI cannot locate concealed asbestos or replace competent sampling and accredited laboratory analysis
countervailingForce: Records computer vision and building data can target where physical work is needed
leadingIndicator: Share of surveys requiring samples and discrepancies between records and site findings
commercialImplication: Asbestos remains a provider-led lane with AI around the work
limitations: Non-invasive sensing may improve but is not evidenced here

claim: AI cannot lawfully perform covered gas work without a correctly qualified registered engineer
countervailingForce: Diagnostics and scheduling can compress preparation
leadingIndicator: Registered-engineer hours per job and repeat visit rate
commercialImplication: Integrate qualified fulfilment rather than promise autonomous delivery
limitations: Future regulation and remote diagnostics may change task boundaries

claim: LOLER and PSSR examinations preserve independent competent-person work even when records and sensor data improve
countervailingForce: Examination schemes and in-house competence can reduce external purchasing
leadingIndicator: External examination share and sensor-supported inspection time
commercialImplication: These lanes have strong durability but slower specialist entry
limitations: Exact customer segment and provider economics are unresearched

claim: Anomaly detection can prioritize unusual readings missed checks and repeated loss of control
countervailingForce: Bad baselines and complex systems make human interpretation essential
leadingIndicator: Critical anomaly recall alert precision and time to corrective action
commercialImplication: Sell monitored exception handling only after site-specific validation
limitations: No water-safety evaluation dataset exists

claim: AI can extract plans and prepare evidence but assessor-directed verified collection remains necessary
countervailingForce: Accredited assessor oversight and lodged-software rules constrain automation
leadingIndicator: Assessor review time resurvey rate and lodgement rejection
commercialImplication: A tool can improve accredited workflow but cannot sell remote synthetic EPCs
limitations: Accreditation-scheme implementation details were not compared

claim: Abundant generated advice creates demand for source-linked jurisdiction-aware verification
countervailingForce: Official guidance remains freely available and incumbents can add citations
leadingIndicator: Share of user questions containing false premises and correction acceptance
commercialImplication: Verification may be a feature but not a standalone moat without workflow evidence
limitations: Demand and willingness to pay are unmeasured

claim: AI can summarize open actions and evidence gaps across sites if the underlying records are structured and current
countervailingForce: A polished summary can conceal incomplete or stale source records
leadingIndicator: Summary claim support coverage and executive corrections
commercialImplication: Generate reporting from the evidence graph rather than from uploaded prose alone
limitations: No portfolio reporting test has been run

claim: An agent can reduce quote collection but should not autonomously approve provider competence or conflicts
countervailingForce: Human approval and redundant provider coverage bound routing risk
leadingIndicator: Agent-routed quote share credential exceptions and price dispersion
commercialImplication: Provide structured provider facts and retain approval rather than resist agent interfaces
limitations: Provider APIs and buyer adoption are unknown

claim: Customers can retain AI savings through lower prices unless the operator converts speed into more capacity retention or service depth
countervailingForce: Provider scarcity and service quality can preserve margin
leadingIndicator: Price per assessment gross contribution and turnaround before and after AI
commercialImplication: Model captured contribution rather than assuming time saved becomes profit
limitations: No before-and-after margin data exists

claim: Template generation report drafting and document chat are reproducible features rather than durable company moats
countervailingForce: Deep integrations controlled rules evidence quality and distribution are harder to copy
leadingIndicator: Feature price compression and incumbent release cadence
commercialImplication: Avoid a pure AI wrapper thesis
limitations: Implementation quality still varies across products

claim: AI increases the need for versioned jurisdiction and effective-date controls because laws guidance and policy proposals differ
countervailingForce: A deterministic rules layer and professional change approval can contain drift
leadingIndicator: Stale-rule incidents and time from authoritative change to approved rule
commercialImplication: Rule governance is an operating function not a one-off prompt
limitations: Standards behind paywalls may limit complete automation

claim: Connected AI creates prompt-injection data-leakage and model-supply risks around building plans tenant data and security controls
countervailingForce: Least privilege sanitisation approved connectors logging and model portability reduce exposure
leadingIndicator: Red-team failures leakage incidents and concentration by model provider
commercialImplication: Security architecture is part of product cost and enterprise trust
limitations: No product threat model or penetration test exists

claim: Synthetic photos signatures observations and certificates can make a report look complete without corresponding physical work
countervailingForce: Immutable originals metadata signatures and independent provider checks can expose fabrication
leadingIndicator: Provenance failures duplicate images and unauthorised signatures
commercialImplication: Never allow generated media or text to stand in for observed evidence
limitations: No fraud-incidence data was found

claim: Vision and sensor systems may reduce repeat inspection effort but cannot safely infer concealed condition or complete compliance from absence of a visible defect
countervailingForce: Physical inspection standards and false-negative risk constrain substitution
leadingIndicator: Remote-only close rate false-negative rate and reinspection findings
commercialImplication: Use remote evidence for triage and follow-up not universal replacement
limitations: No sector-specific model performance evidence was retained

claim: An agent that closes an action without valid completion evidence creates paper compliance and concentrated safety risk
countervailingForce: Create-only permissions named ownership and human acceptance prevent silent closure
leadingIndicator: False closure count reopened actions and source-complete closure rate
commercialImplication: Automate reminders and packet assembly but prohibit autonomous attestation
limitations: PlanRadar controls are one vendor example rather than a sector standard
